request.description: The logged-in user becomes the creator. Dates are `yyyy-MM-dd`; the end must not be before the start (the same day is a one-day trip). `name` and `destination` are required (up to 100 characters); `budget` (up to 2 decimals, not negative) and `description` (up to 2000 characters) are optional. Answers 201 with `Location`, 400 or 401. The cover is set afterwards with `PUT /api/v1/trips/{id}/cover`.

request.description: Only the creator. Returns the bytes of the cover with its `Content-Type` and `Cache-Control: no-cache`. 404 when the trip does not exist or has no cover (the web application then shows its default image). The web application reads covers through the public `GET /api/v1/images/{coverImageId}`.
Only the creator. Deletes the cover image. Also answers 204 when there was no cover. 401, 403 or 404.

item.name: Get trip cost and remaining budget

request.description: Only the trip's creator. `totalCost` is the sum of the costs of all the activities (0 without any cost) and `remainingBudget` is the trip's budget minus that total, negative when the activities cost more and null when the trip has no budget. 400 for an id that is not a number, 401, 403 and 404.

request.description: Only the trip's creator, who becomes the author. `name` (up to 100 characters) and `date` are required, and `date` must be within the trip's dates. Times are `HH:mm`: the end must be strictly after the start and cannot be given without a start. `location` (200), `description` (2000), `cost` (up to 2 decimals, not negative) and `category` (`SIGHTSEEING`, `FOOD`, `TRANSPORT`, `ACCOMMODATION`, `LEISURE`, `OTHER`) are optional. Answers 201 with `Location`, 400, 401, 403 or 404. The image is set afterwards with `PUT .../activities/{id}/image`.
Only the trip's creator. 400 for an id that is not a number, 401, 403, and 404 when the trip does not exist or the activity belongs to another trip.

Only the trip's creator. Uploads the image in the `file` part: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Answers 201 with `Location` the first time and 200 when it replaces the previous image (which is deleted), 400 for a file that is not a valid image, 401, 403, 404 and 413 for a file that is too large.

Only the trip's creator. Returns the bytes of the image with its `Content-Type`, not cached. 404 also when the activity has no image. The app shows the image through the public `GET /api/v1/images/{imageId}`.
Only the trip's creator. Deletes the image. Also answers 204 when there was none. 401, 403 or 404.

Only the trip's creator. Warnings about the itinerary, never errors: `overlaps` are pairs of activities of the same day whose times intersect (times that only touch do not, and activities without start and end time are ignored), `outsideDates` are activities before the trip starts or after it ends (possible after editing the trip's dates), and `budget` is set only when the total cost is above the trip's budget, otherwise null. All empty and null when there is nothing to warn about. 400 for an id that is not a number, 401, 403 and 404.

request.description: Registers a regular user (public). Answers 201 with a Location header and the user without the password, 400 for invalid data and 409 if the email is already registered. It does not log in: call Login afterwards.

Logs in with email and password. The response sets the HttpOnly `AuthToken` cookie, which Postman stores and sends in later requests. The default development administrator is admin@tripmate.com / admin.

request.description: Edits the name and email of one's own profile (same rules as registration; the email is stored in lower case). The session stays open after an email change. Answers 200 with the profile, 400 for invalid data, 401, 403 (another user, or the administrator, whose details come from the configuration), 404 and 409 if the email is already registered.

Changes one's own password. Requires the current password; the new one has 8 to 72 characters. Answers 204, 400 (invalid new password or incorrect current password), 401, 403 (another user, or the administrator) and 404. Sessions already open stay valid until their token expires.

Uploads the avatar of one's own profile in the `file` part: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Answers 201 with `Location` the first time and 200 when it replaces the previous avatar (which is deleted), 400 for a file that is not a valid image, 401, 403, 404 and 413 for a file that is too large. The administrator can also change their avatar.
